call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Generate exactly ONE completed flat Korean online beach-cleanup recruitment poster, landscape aspect ratio exactly 3:2, edge-to-edge poster artwork. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력. Use the maximum supported native resolution, not an upscaled simulation. Opaque background. No mockup, frame, photographed poster, contact sheet, comparison, multiple panels or collage.

Design the text area and cleanup action together from the start. A one-scene cooperative handoff connects the participation decision on the left to practical arrival and preparation on the right. Replace the generic image-with-info-cards format with careful open typography and an illustrated shoreline whose shared collection point occupies the space between adjacent sentence groups. No rounded cards, no colored call-to-action box, no buttons, no title stretched across the full page, no footer band. No added headings, icons, decorative typographic marks, divider rules, symbols, logos or QR code.

Concrete composition: On a clean very pale blue background, use asymmetrical two-sided typography with a central/lower cooperative scene. The left reading area starts with the recruitment name, strongly set in two balanced lines. The emotional headline sits closely with it in a somewhat smaller deliberate two-line setting. Immediately adjacent below is the application deadline and complete URL as prominent dark teal type, with the URL in one uninterrupted line. Eligibility and free/no-certificate conditions belong near this same application group as substantial readable text, with the inquiry beside it. On the right, event date, assembly/end time and assembly place begin a related arrival group. The supplied tools and personal preparation sentences sit below, alongside the scene's shared bag and the tool handoff rather than as labels trapped in boxes. The rain/cancellation notice belongs with this right-side preparation group, in a broad natural two-line paragraph if needed. These information groups are not rigid boxes or matching columns; step their margins and line lengths around the central scene so the bag's opening and the continuous picker shaft visibly lead between the two functional groups. Clear blank paper is the reading surface, never text printed over bodies or water. All twelve texts must be readable at a 720-pixel-wide view. Body lettering must remain substantial with generous line spacing; reduce the scene rather than using tiny copy.

Show exactly TWO adult volunteers in ONE simultaneous shared shoreline action, illustrated with refined economical solid shapes and consistent precise dark outlines. One person stands slightly bent, holding ONE conventional litter picker by ONE pistol-style handgrip with a visible small trigger. A SINGLE rigid shaft continues without gaps from that handgrip down toward ONE pair of short opposed gripping jaws. Those jaws visibly grip the middle of a small discarded bottle just above the opening of a collection bag. The second person keeps the bag open with two gloved hands, one on each rim, and receives the bottle. The bottle, jaws and bag opening must have clean separate boundaries. No double long rods, no scissor poles, no extra handles, no spare tools and no implausible hand-to-tool intersections. The operator's other hand is free, naturally at the hip or resting on the knee. Show clear fingers only where needed, correct arm continuity, visible stable feet contacting the same sand plane and a consistent modest ground shadow. The actual gripped bottle is the only featured litter object; do not decorate the beach with extra rubbish.

Draw a shallow gently diagonal sand/sea edge through this single shared work scene, rising toward the arrival/preparation group. The shoreline supports the text's open margins and connects the shared action to the neighboring preparation copy; it is not a large scenic photograph behind generic text. Keep the coast a small, specific spatial setting with a few restrained water shapes, no elaborate distant landscape, sunbursts or decorative clouds. The typography and working boundary should create the major poster forms together. Matte restrained teal, pale blue, sandy tan and a muted coral for a small useful text emphasis; avoid global texture, grain, glow, faux print noise, ornamental props or unmotivated surface effects.

Only the following twelve exact text values may appear, each exactly ONCE. Preserve every Korean glyph, space, punctuation mark, Latin case, digit and full URL. Natural line breaks between words may be used without altering values. Never wrap within the URL. Do not duplicate a phrase as a caption or invent headings:
우리 바다, 함께 줍는 토요일
하람 해변 정화 참여자 모집
2026년 11월 21일 토요일
오전 9시 30분 집결 · 낮 12시 종료
하람시 물결마당 앞 · 파도길 8
대상: 만 14세 이상 누구나 · 선착순 40명
집게와 수거 봉투는 제공됩니다.
개인 장갑, 마실 물, 모자를 준비해 주세요.
우천 시 취소되며 신청자에게 전날 문자로 안내합니다.
참가비 무료 · 봉사 확인서는 발급하지 않습니다.
11월 18일까지 신청: haram-wave.example/join
문의: 바다정화 운영팀

Render clean robust Korean sans-serif text with controlled word spacing, no broken glyphs, high contrast and comfortable safe margins. Distinguish the event date from the application deadline, and distinguish supplied equipment from personal items. The application deadline and full URL should be located immediately without searching. Do not print these production instructions. Deliver one complete independently designed 3:2 flat poster.
